name: ASM · Job Runner
description: Runs one ASM stage script detached on the host (setsid + timeout), polls for completion, returns result.json. Called by every stage module.

parameters.command:
=D='{{ $json.job_dir }}'
case "$D" in /opt/loot/asm/*/*/*) ;; *) echo 'bad job dir' >&2; exit 1;; esac
mkdir -p "$D" && cd "$D" || exit 1
rm -f .done result.json
printf '%s' '{{ $json.script_b64 }}' | base64 -d > job.sh
setsid nohup bash -c 'timeout {{ $json.max_minutes }}m bash job.sh > job.log 2>&1; echo $? > .done' > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo '{"launched":true}'

=cd '{{ $('Validate Job').first().json.job_dir }}' || exit 1
for i in $(seq 1 22); do [ -f .done ] && break; sleep 5; done
if [ ! -f .done ]; then echo '{"done":false}'; exit 0; fi
rc=$(tr -dc 0-9 < .done); [ -n "$rc" ] || rc=1
if jq -e . result.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then res=$(jq -c . result.json); else res=null; fi
jq -nc --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson r "$res" --arg tail "$(tail -c 1500 job.log 2>/dev/null)" '{done: true, rc: $rc, result: $r, log_tail: $tail}'
